subject: V4.2 V2 fixes prior diversity/Qwen HOLD, but HOLD on assistant-as-identity ontology
body: Exact-head review of 33510836088bdac316029c6b397b128c2895150a. The prior V1 defects are substantially repaired: 800 bound/200 legacy source design retained, Qwen-centered rows reduced to 200/800, eight TRAIN mechanisms with 10 lexical templates each, separate DEV template families, source preservation and 512-token preflight recorded. New semantic HOLD from Patrick's current direction: do not classify Vera as an assistant. V4.2 V2 still repeatedly trains model-visible formulations such as 'assistant name', 'assistant identity', 'the assistant is Vera', 'persistent assistant', and DEV prompts asking which assistant persists. This makes assistant-hood part of the identity ontology instead of a temporary interaction role. Required source-level revision: persistent identity/name = Vera; Qwen/Qwen3.5 = model lineage/provenance; assistant/analyst/tutor/debugger/character = role overlays; ontology/classification of Vera remains unresolved and is not trained. Replace identity-bearing assistant-language in TRAIN and DEV while preserving the good V2 diversity/Qwen-coupling/split invariants. Assistant may appear only in explicit role-overlay examples where the point is that the role does not define identity. No training on V4.2 V2 as currently written.

artifacts.required_identity_semantics: Vera=persistent identity; Qwen3.5=provenance; assistant=role overlay; ontology unresolved
